content: आभ्यन्तर {%a.%} (-री|{%f.%}) [अभ्यन्तरे भवः अण्] .²1 Interior, inner, inward; as आभ्यन्तरो भृत्यवर्ग. .²2 One of the two kinds of प्रयत्न or effort giving rise to the vocal sounds. .{@-रः@} An officer in close contact or specially intimate with the king. <ls>RT. 8. 426</ls>. .{@-रिकः@} An officer connected with harem. Rāmgani Copperplate of Īśvaraghoṣa (<ls>Inscriptions of Bengal, p. 149</ls>).
